label.en: Valid passport (6+ months beyond stay)

howToMeet.en: Apply at Sierra Leone Immigration Department; allow several weeks.

label.en: WASSCE with at least 5 credits incl. English and Maths

howToMeet.en: Request your WAEC result slip and scratch card; most universities verify online.

label.en: Completed bachelor's degree (ISCED 6)

howToMeet.en: Transcript + certificate; many programmes accept final-year students with a provisional letter.

label.en: Bachelor's with Second Class Upper or better

howToMeet.en: If below, look for programmes with lower grade thresholds or add work experience.

label.en: English: IELTS 6.0 (or equivalent, B2)

howToMeet.en: Book IELTS at British Council Freetown; results in 3–13 days. TOEFL iBT and Duolingo are accepted by many universities.

label.en: English: IELTS 6.5 (or equivalent, B2+)

howToMeet.en: Most English-taught master's programmes in Europe ask for 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0.

label.en: English: IELTS 7.0 (C1)

howToMeet.en: Required by selective business schools and some scholarships.

label.en: German B1 (Goethe-Zertifikat B1 or telc B1)

howToMeet.en: Roughly 350–650 guided learning hours from zero. Goethe-Institut online courses; no Goethe-Institut in Sierra Leone – nearest exam centres in Accra and Lagos (verify).

label.en: German B2

howToMeet.en: Needed for vocational training (Ausbildung) in most trades and for many jobs.

label.en: German C1 (TestDaF 4 / DSH-2)

howToMeet.en: Required for German-taught degree programmes.

label.en: French B2 (DELF B2 / TCF)

howToMeet.en: Required for French-taught programmes; Alliance Française Freetown offers courses and DELF exams (verify).

label.en: Blocked account: EUR 11,904 for one year (EUR 992/month)

howToMeet.en: Open with an approved provider (e.g. Expatrio, Fintiba, Coracle); transfer the full amount before the visa appointment. A scholarship letter or a formal obligation letter (Verpflichtungserklärung) can replace it.

provenance.quote: EUR 11,904 per year / EUR 992 per month (checked 2026-11-01). Amount changes with BAföG rates – re-check each January.

label.en: Job offer with gross salary ≥ EUR 50,700 (EUR 45,934.20 in shortage occupations or for recent graduates), 2026

howToMeet.en: Thresholds are set every year; the lower threshold applies to shortage occupations and to graduates within three years of their degree.

label.en: UK maintenance funds: GBP 1,136 per month for up to 9 months (outside London)

howToMeet.en: Money must be held for 28 consecutive days; London rate is higher (GBP 1,483/month). Verify current figures on GOV.UK.

label.en: Ireland: proof of EUR 12,000 for living costs (verify)

howToMeet.en: Figure raised in 2025 for courses longer than 6 months – verify on irishimmigration.ie.

label.en: Admission letter from the institution

howToMeet.en: Apply before the deadline; conditional offers are usually accepted for visa purposes.

label.en: Health insurance valid in the destination country

howToMeet.en: Travel insurance for the visa period, then statutory student insurance after arrival (Germany: approx. EUR 130–150/month, estimate).

label.en: At least 2 years (2,800 hours) of work experience

howToMeet.en: Paid or voluntary work counts for Chevening; internships count too.

label.en: No more than 12 months of full-time work experience

howToMeet.en: Deutsche Bank graduate programmes accept at most 12 months of full-time experience (checked 2026-11-01).

label.en: University listed H+ in anabin and degree rated 'entspricht'/'gleichwertig'

howToMeet.en: Search anabin for your university; if not listed or H+/-, request a Statement of Comparability from ZAB (fee, several weeks).

provenance.quote: H+: the university is recognised in Germany. H+/-: the degree must also be listed. The degree must be rated 'entspricht' or 'gleichwertig'.

label.en: GMAT or GRE (selective finance master's)

howToMeet.en: GMAT Focus is offered online; many schools waive it for strong grades.

label.en: Relevant bachelor's degree, ideally in computer science

howToMeet.en: Aalto expects a high-quality bachelor's in computer science; other related fields may be considered.

provenance.quote: Applicants are expected to have a high-quality Bachelor's degree in computer science

label.en: GRE General Test (required with a non-EU/EEA bachelor's)

howToMeet.en: Aalto ML, Data Science and AI: GRE is obligatory in Admission group 2 (bachelor's from outside the EU/EEA). GRE is offered at home online or at test centres.

provenance.quote: In Admission group 2, the Graduate Records Examination (GRE) test is obligatory.

label.en: English: IELTS Academic 6.5, writing 6.0 (Aalto)

howToMeet.en: TOEFL iBT also accepted. Exempt if at least half of your bachelor's was taught in English in Sierra Leone while you lived there.

provenance.quote: IELTS Academic: overall score 6.5 and writing score 6.0. IELTS test results are valid for two years from the date of the test. … Sierra Leone, Singapore, South Africa … A minimum of one half of the degree must be completed in English in a country listed above.

label.en: Completed medical degree from outside the EU (e.g. MBChB)

howToMeet.en: Certificate plus proof of content and duration (diploma supplement or transcript), with certified German translations.

provenance.quote: Nachweise Ihrer Berufsqualifikation (zum Beispiel Zeugnisse, Berufsurkunde) … Nachweise über Inhalt und Dauer Ihrer Ausbildung (zum Beispiel Diploma Supplement, Transcript of Records)

label.en: Proof you may practise medicine in your country of training

howToMeet.en: Ask the medical regulator in Sierra Leone for a certificate of registration / good standing.

provenance.quote: Nachweis, dass Sie in Ihrem Ausbildungsland in dem Beruf arbeiten dürfen

label.en: Police clearance from your home country (max. 3 months old)

howToMeet.en: Usually handed in later in the procedure; request it shortly before.

provenance.quote: Strafregisterauszug oder Führungszeugnis aus Ihrem Herkunftsstaat (maximal 3 Monate alt)

label.en: Medical certificate of fitness (max. 3 months old)

howToMeet.en: Usually handed in later in the procedure; request it shortly before.

label.en: Medical German C1 (Fachsprachprüfung)

howToMeet.en: Taken at the state medical chamber: doctor–patient talk, talk with a colleague, doctor's letter. Fee about EUR 250–450. General German B2 (ALTE certificate, e.g. Goethe, telc, ÖSD) comes first.

provenance.quote: Allgemeine Sprachkenntnisse auf dem Niveau B2 … Kenntnisse über die Fachsprache Medizin / Zahnmedizin / Pharmazie auf dem Niveau C1 … zwischen etwa 250 und 450 Euro

label.en: Kenntnisprüfung (state exam: internal medicine and surgery)

howToMeet.en: Oral-practical, 60–90 minutes, with a patient case. Can be repeated twice. Since 1 Nov 2026 the direct Kenntnisprüfung is the standard route; a document-based equivalence check is optional.

provenance.quote: Die Kenntnisprüfung ist eine mündlich-praktische Prüfung, der eine patientenbezogene Prüfungsvorbereitung vorangestellt ist. … Inhalt der Kenntnisprüfung sind die Fächer Innere Medizin und Chirurgie. … mindestens 60, höchstens 90 Minuten. … Sie kann zweimal wiederholt werden.

label.en: Approbation (full licence to practise medicine in Germany)

howToMeet.en: Apply to the licensing authority of the federal state where you want to work. A Berufserlaubnis is a temporary alternative: work only under supervision of a licensed doctor.

provenance.quote: Approbation Ärztin oder Arzt mit Berufsqualifikation aus Drittstaat beantragen … Falls es Ihnen nicht möglich ist, die wesentlichen Unterschiede auszugleichen, können Sie eine Kenntnisprüfung ablegen.

label.en: German A2 (minimum for a § 16d recognition permit)

howToMeet.en: § 16d asks for German that fits the measure or exam, as a rule at least A2.

provenance.quote: (10) Hinreichende deutsche Sprachkenntnisse entsprechen dem Niveau A 2

label.en: Bachelor in electric power engineering or related, with 30 ECTS maths (incl. 5 statistics) and 7.5 ECTS physics

howToMeet.en: Check your transcript credits against the NTNU list of accepted bachelor's fields.

provenance.quote: The candidates must have a minimum of the equivalent of 30 ECTS in mathematics, including 5 ECTS in statistics. … a minimum 7,5 ECTS in physics or physics and electromagnetism. … An average grade equivalent to a Norwegian C is required.

label.en: Bachelor's average grade C or better (ECTS scale)

howToMeet.en: NTNU converts your grades to the ECTS scale; aim for a strong upper-second or better.

provenance.quote: To be admitted to most programmes of study, applicants must have a relevant bachelor's degree with a grade point average of at least C.

label.en: English: IELTS Academic 6.5 in each part (NTNU)

howToMeet.en: TOEFL iBT also accepted. A bachelor's taught in English in Sierra Leone exempts you. Tests must be under two years old at the deadline.

provenance.quote: Academic test with a minimum band score of 6.5 on each part of the test.
